momentous.purpose: Refresh the existing internal candidate registry and extend it to 30 current distinct brand products for review.
momentous.selectionBasis: Preserve 24 verifiable legacy identities, add six distinct current formulas. Order follows record lineage; not a sales, bestseller, clinical, or market ranking.
momentous.scope: One selected flavor/pack per base product; flavors, travel packs, bundles, accessories, and alternate bottle counts do not increase the count.

officialDomainVerification.statementSummary: The brand identifies livemomentous.com as its only official website.

momentous.qualificationNote: Brand SKU identifiers and retail prices are research references; they are not approved Xenios SKUs, prices, inventory, reseller rights, or image licenses.
momentous.labelPolicy: Composition and serving fields are internal label evidence only. No administration, dosing, timing, regimen, efficacy, or personalized recommendation is supplied.
momentous.nullPolicy: Null means not confirmed in this research. Missing allergen or caution statements never mean allergen-free or safe. Empty otherIngredients arrays are used only where the label explicitly says none.
